title: run-ledger.json
description: Shape is normative here; semantics live in ../run-ledger.md. The enums restate the closed vocabularies exported by plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/governance-profile.js (DELIVERY_PROFILE) — that module is the implementation source of truth, this schema mirrors it. additionalProperties is intentionally true: the ledger is an open, orchestrator-extended record and this schema closes only the fields consumers gate on (FAFF-601 v0.1 Design Decision Rationale, 'How strict is the run-ledger schema?').

admitted.description: issue ids admitted to the build queue

outcomes.description: per-issue terminal outcome; string-only (FAFF-554) — rich detail lives in outcome_details, never inline here

owner.description: legacy-tolerated absent — a run-ledger with no owner block is still liveness-valid

budget.description: envelope + token checkpoints; documented, not closed — shape varies by budget policy

outcome_details.description: rich per-issue detail sidecar (FAFF-554) — outcomes[] stays string-only
